item.title: Misconceptions About Pesah
item.description:
Pesah preparation without the myths: search for pieces of hames, not crumbs, and only where hames is brought; children, cars and pockets, the ten pieces, disposing of hames, and when natural products, medicines, vitamins and cosmetics need a hekhsher.

item.title: Kashering Utensils
item.description:
Kashering utensils for Pesah from its Torah sources: metal pots by hagalah, plates and cutlery by pouring boiling water, pans with little oil, and why non-stick pans, earthenware and china cannot be kashered and must be put away.

item.title: The Seder Night
item.description:
The Seder from Kaddesh to Nirsah, step by step: the measures for the four cups and the massah, when to lean, Urhas and Karpas, breaking the middle massah, what Maggid must include, Maror and Korekh, and eating the Afikoman before midnight.
